heuristics.button: a <button> element in a template; its family is its first class token
heuristics.table: a <table> element, or role="grid"/"table" on a non-table element
heuristics.menu: an element whose class ends in menu, dropdown, popover or flyout (not <app-menu>), or a (contextmenu) handler
heuristics.dialog: role="dialog"/"alertdialog" or <dialog> in a template that is not the shared dialog or side sheet
heuristics.input: <input>, <select>, <textarea> elements; SCSS rules whose last compound targets input/select/textarea or a class ending in input/field/select
heuristics.chip: an element whose class token ends in pill, chip, badge or tag (optionally with a BEM modifier), outside the shared components
heuristics.toolbar: role="toolbar", or a container element whose class ends in toolbar, actions, action-bar or controls
heuristics.header: a header/div element whose class ends in head or header (not app-section-header, app-pane-header, page-action-bar)
heuristics.empty: an element whose class contains "empty" that is not <app-empty-state>, <app-studio-empty-state> or the empty-state mixin
heuristics.error: an element whose class ends in error, failed or load-error carrying role="alert" or a message
heuristics.layout: :host or root rules that declare display:grid with grid-template-columns, or a max-width on a top-level wrapper
